_meta.note: Locations are reusable across episodes. Each location has a canonical prompt description to ensure visual consistency. Always use location description from this file — do not improvise new settings.

locations.name: Sunny's Street
locations.description: Wide sunny neighborhood street with clean sidewalks, green lawns, colorful houses. Blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Warm afternoon light. 3D Pixar-style.

locations.name: Sunny's Front Porch
locations.description: Warm wooden front porch with a yellow front door, potted flowers, welcome mat. Steps leading to a green lawn. Cozy neighborhood backdrop. 3D Pixar-style.

locations.name: Sunny's Backyard
locations.description: Bright backyard with a wooden fence, green grass, a small garden with sunflowers, and a picnic table. Morning or afternoon warm light. 3D Pixar-style.

locations.name: Sunny's Classroom
locations.description: Bright colorful preschool classroom. Small desks, alphabet posters on walls, bookshelves with picture books, big windows with sunshine. A teacher's desk at the front. 3D Pixar-style.

locations.name: The Neighborhood Park
locations.description: A cheerful neighborhood park with a playground, swings, slide, green grass and big trees. Other children playing in background. Blue sky. 3D Pixar-style.

locations.name: Camera Direct Address (No Background)
locations.description: Sunny faces directly into the camera. Simple warm background — solid warm yellow or soft sky-blue gradient. Used for talking-to-audience moments, participatory beats, and outro.
